unit: section (the API's sectionId grouping — one or more numbered provisions e.g. COBS 20.1.1, COBS 20.1.2 sharing one section heading)
method: full recursive walk of GetAllHandbook (one call; declares the whole module > chapter > section tree with 62 sourcebooks, 970 chapters, 3798 unique section entityIds) cross-checked by an independent entry walk of 3 sample chapters via GetAllHandBookProvisionsSortedOrderByChapter (1 small, 1 median, 1 large by section count) — all 3 matched the tree-declared count exactly, 0 discrepancies
notes: Supersedes the former corpus_targets.est_sections of 150,000, which was self-referential (see prior note) and never based on a publisher index. This walk uses the API's own hierarchy as the index. Held count (3,661) was captured 7 Jun 2026 via this same API; live count (3798) as of 2026-09-25 is higher by 137 — plausible ~3.5-month drift on a continuously-amended rulebook, not evidence of a broken walk (module lastmodifieddate fields seen up to 01/09/2026). 22 held section ids do not appear in the live tree (renamed/merged/deleted since ingest) — see corpus-held-not-live count; not included in absent_ids (that field is live-not-held only, per schema convention).
